tracks.title: Is the Bible reliable?
tracks.blurb: How we know the Gospels are early, faithfully copied, grounded in real places, and honest eyewitness accounts.

tracks.title: Did Jesus rise?
tracks.blurb: Why the disciples' transformation, the death on the cross, and the eyewitnesses point to a real resurrection.

tracks.title: Where does morality come from?
tracks.blurb: Why right and wrong can't be decided by vote, contract or chemistry, and what that says about God.

tracks.title: Is the universe designed?
tracks.blurb: Why a finely tuned cosmos with a beginning, and life written in code, point to a Mind behind it all.

tracks.title: Why does God allow evil?
tracks.blurb: Why real love needs real freedom, and why the innocent so often suffer for other people's choices.

tracks.title: Is the God of the Old Testament cruel?
tracks.blurb: What the laws on slavery and the judgment on Canaan actually said, and why they don't make God a tyrant.
